parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file passes. It is an Express error-handling middleware in the presentation layer. Its only job is to turn error names into HTTP status codes and send responses, while logging to the console. Turning errors into HTTP responses is transport work, which belongs in the presentation layer. The file has no business rules, no persistence and no domain decisions; it only reads error.name values that other layers have already set. It does have a separate bug: there are no early returns, so the code can try to send more than one response. That is a correctness problem, not a layer-responsibility problem, so it does not affect this rule.
